tasks.subject: Task 1 (Wave 2): PopoverMenu primitive + SettingsDrawer
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A reusable click-to-open panel primitive, and the right-side drawer shell built on the same open/close/Escape/outside-click conventions.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/components/ui/PopoverMenu.tsx`
- Test: `src/components/ui/PopoverMenu.test.tsx`
- Create: `src/components/SettingsDrawer.tsx`
- Test: `src/components/SettingsDrawer.test.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `PopoverMenu` renders its trigger always, content only while open; trigger click toggles; outside click closes; inside click doesn't; Escape closes
- [ ] `SettingsDrawer` renders a title and children
- [ ] `SettingsDrawer` calls `onClose` via X button, backdrop, or Escape, but not via a click inside the panel

**Verify:** `npx vitest run src/components/ui/PopoverMenu.test.tsx src/components/SettingsDrawer.test.tsx` → all tests pass

**Steps:** TDD both components per the plan's full code (render-prop trigger/content API for PopoverMenu; fixed-position backdrop+panel for SettingsDrawer). Full code in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-11-settings-ui-overhaul-wave2.md Task 1.


tasks.subject: Task 3 (Wave 2): IntegrationTile component
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A compact status tile showing the brand logo, name, and connection state, fetching its own status independently of drawer-open state.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/components/IntegrationTile.tsx`
- Test: `src/components/IntegrationTile.test.tsx`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Shows description text and "Connect →" while disconnected
- [ ] Shows the connected label, a "Connected" badge, and "Manage →" once connected
- [ ] Clicking anywhere on the tile calls `onOpen`
- [ ] A failed status fetch falls back to the disconnected appearance rather than crashing

**Verify:** `npx vitest run src/components/IntegrationTile.test.tsx` → all tests pass

**Steps:** TDD the component: self-fetches `statusUrl` on mount via `AbortController`, derives connected/label state, calls a caller-supplied `getConnectedLabel(data)` for the per-integration label extraction. Full code in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-11-settings-ui-overhaul-wave2.md Task 3.

tasks.subject: Task 4 (Wave 2): Rebuild Integrations settings page as card grid + drawer

tasks.subject: Task 5 (Wave 2): Team row normalization, filter, and sort logic
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Pure, independently-testable functions merging members and pending invites into unified rows, filtering by email/status/role, sorting, and aggregating bulk-remove results — the data layer the Team table UI (Task 7) consumes.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/lib/team/rows.ts`
- Test: `src/lib/team/rows.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `normalizeTeamRows` maps active members to `status: "Active"` and pending invites to `"Invited"`/`"Expired"` based on their `expired` flag
- [ ] `filterTeamRows` applies email substring (case-insensitive), status set, and role set filters with AND logic; empty set = no restriction
- [ ] `sortTeamRows` sorts by email (locale-aware) or date, ascending or descending
- [ ] `removableRowIds` excludes the Owner's own member row from a selected-ID set
- [ ] `summarizeRemovalFailures` returns `null` when everything succeeded, else one formatted multi-line message listing only the failed rows

**Verify:** `npx vitest run src/lib/team/rows.test.ts` → all tests pass

**Steps:** TDD all five functions per the plan's full code and test suite (13 tests total). Full code in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-11-settings-ui-overhaul-wave2.md Task 5.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/lib/team/rows.ts", "src/lib/team/rows.test.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx vitest run src/lib/team/rows.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["normalize/filter/sort/removableRowIds/summarizeRemovalFailures all match the spec'd behavior with passing tests"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7 (Wave 2): Rebuild TeamCard as a full data table
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `/settings/team` shows one merged, filterable, sortable table of members and pending invites, with bulk-select + bulk-remove, column visibility, and pagination.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/components/TeamCard.tsx`

**Depends on:** Task 5 (row logic), Task 6 (filter/menu components)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Members and pending invites render as one table, sorted by email ascending by default
- [ ] Email search box filters rows by substring
- [ ] Status and Role dropdown filters combine with the search box and each other via AND logic
- [ ] Clicking the Email or Joined column header toggles sort field/direction
- [ ] "View" menu can hide/show Role, Status, and Joined columns
- [ ] Row checkboxes only appear for the Owner, never for the Owner's own row
- [ ] Selecting rows and "Remove selected" removes each via the existing per-row endpoints, aggregates failures via `summarizeRemovalFailures`, refreshes the table
- [ ] Row action menu shows Remove (Owner viewing Member), Resend/Revoke (Owner viewing invite), Leave team (Member viewing own row), or nothing otherwise
- [ ] Pagination (rows-per-page selector, Previous/Next, "Page X of Y") works against the filtered/sorted set

**Verify:** Manual browser verification per the plan's 8-step checklist (automated coverage lives in Task 5's pure-logic tests)

**Steps:** Full component rewrite reusing the existing data-fetch functions (`refresh`, `sendInvite`, `removeMember`, `leaveTeam`, `resendInvite`, `revokeInvite`) verbatim, consuming `normalizeTeamRows`/`filterTeamRows`/`sortTeamRows`/`removableRowIds`/`summarizeRemovalFailures` from Task 5 and `MultiSelectFilter`/`ColumnVisibilityMenu`/`RowActionsMenu` from Task 6. Full code in docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-11-settings-ui-overhaul-wave2.md Task 7.

